# usaspend

An R package that takes a list of SAM.gov UEIs and returns a clean,
normalized panel of federal award activity from USAspending.gov, at
**organization × award × year** grain.

> **Status: acquisition layer works; the accounting layer is specified
> but not yet implemented.** The normalization and netting functions are
> documented placeholders that fail loudly with a pointer to their
> specification. They are being written against a 50-nonprofit pilot
> extract. See
> [PLAN.md](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/PLAN.md)
> §7 for the roadmap.

## What it does

Transaction data is a ledger of promises: new awards, continuations,
revisions, zero-dollar administrative modifications, and claw-backs. The
panel needs one row per organization, award and year carrying the
awarding agency, the award type, the net dollars obligated in that year,
and the dollars passed through as subawards.

``` r
# one organization
ex <- us_extract("CFFMYPABYAG3", years = 2015:2025, subawards = "both")

# a batch, via the annual bulk archives instead of the API
ueis <- readLines("TOP1000-UEIS.txt")
ex   <- us_extract(ueis, years = 2008:2025, source = "archive")

# not implemented yet -- see ACCOUNTING.md
p <- us_panel(ex, org_map = crosswalk, period = "calendar")
```

Not sure which path?
[`us_extract_plan()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_extract_plan.md)
costs both from measured constants and recommends one; `source = "auto"`
follows it. Crossover is around 2,900 UEIs at 18 fiscal years.

## Two acquisition paths, one schema

|  | API (`source = "api"`) | Archive (`source = "archive"`) |
|----|----|----|
| endpoint | `POST /api/v2/download/transactions/` | `FY####_All_{Assistance,Contracts}_Full.zip` |
| cost scales with | number of UEIs | number of fiscal years |
| best for | one org, or up to a few thousand UEIs | large batches |
| subawards | inbound only, as a by-product | none |

Both land on the same canonical schema
([`us_schema()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_schema.md)),
so nothing downstream knows or cares which was used.

## Three things that will bite you

1.  **Obligations are not payments.** The panel measures commitments.
    Federal award data carries no annual cash figure — lifetime outlays
    only, and those are complete only for awards begun after the FY2022
    monthly reporting mandate (for some agencies not even then).
    `us_money_column("outlay")` errors rather than substituting
    something close;
    [`us_add_outlays()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_add_outlays.md)
    can attach account-level annual outlays to a fiscal panel as a
    separate, coverage-graded column.
2.  **Bulk subawards run the wrong way.** Filtering on
    `recipient_search_text` returns subawards where your UEI is the
    *subawardee*, not the prime. A three-UEI test pull returned 32
    subaward rows, all 32 inbound. Pass-through has to be queried per
    prime award —
    [`us_fetch_subawards_out()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_subawards_out.md).
3.  **De-obligations are real and must be kept.** Dropping them inflates
    every affected year. Which year a claw-back lands in is a policy
    choice, not a cleanup step; both policies are implemented and
    neither is applied silently.

## Documentation

- **[PLAN.md](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/PLAN.md)**
  — architecture, both acquisition paths with measured constraints,
  roadmap, open questions
- **[ACCOUNTING.md](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/ACCOUNTING.md)**
  — the reconciliation rules: what counts as money, netting,
  de-obligation policy, subaward direction, reconciliation invariants

## Install

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Nonprofit-Open-Data-Collective/usaspend")
```

Requires `httr2`, `data.table`, `duckdb`, `DBI` and `cli`.

## Test fixture

[`us_sample_extract()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_sample_extract.md)
returns a real 152-row three-UEI pull, shipped verbatim. It is small but
already contains an award whose transactions reconcile exactly to its
lifetime total, a de-obligating revision, 30 zero-dollar administrative
modifications, IDV rows with blank award types, unstable description
strings, and a \$40M ceiling against \$0 obligated. It caught two live
bugs during development.

# Package index

## The pipeline

From a list of UEIs to an ORG x AWARD x YEAR panel of net federal
revenue.
[`us_extract()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_extract.md)
acquires,
[`us_panel()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_panel.md)
normalizes and nets,
[`us_rollup()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_rollup.md)
aggregates.

- [`us_extract()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_extract.md)
  : Extract raw award data for a set of UEIs
- [`us_panel()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_panel.md)
  : Build the organization x award x year panel
- [`us_rollup()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_rollup.md)
  : Roll the panel up across grouping dimensions
- [`us_adjust_inflation()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_adjust_inflation.md)
  : Adjust panel dollars for inflation
- [`us_org_year()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_org_year.md)
  : Roll the award panel up to organization x year

## Planning an extraction

Cost the API path against the annual-archive path before pulling.

- [`us_extract_plan()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_extract_plan.md)
  : Plan an extraction before running it
- [`us_award_counts()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_award_counts.md)
  : Pre-flight award counts for a set of UEIs
- [`us_validate_uei()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_validate_uei.md)
  : Validate a vector of UEIs
- [`us_org_map()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_org_map.md)
  : Map UEIs to organizations
- [`us_find_subsidiaries()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_find_subsidiaries.md)
  : Find subsidiaries surfaced by the parent-UEI match
- [`us_add_subsidiaries()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_add_subsidiaries.md)
  : Extract the full histories of an extract's subsidiaries

## Acquisition: REST API

Bulk transaction download jobs, for one organization or a small batch.

- [`us_download_run()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_download_run.md)
  : Run a set of download jobs to completion
- [`us_download_submit()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_download_submit.md)
  : Submit a bulk transaction download job
- [`us_download_status()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_download_status.md)
  : Poll a download job
- [`us_download_fetch()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_download_fetch.md)
  : Download and unzip finished jobs
- [`us_api()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_api.md)
  : Call the USAspending API

## Acquisition: annual archives

Whole-fiscal-year files filtered locally with duckdb, for large batches.

- [`us_archive_manifest()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_archive_manifest.md)
  : List available annual archive files
- [`us_archive_size()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_archive_size.md)
  : Size an archive pull before committing to it
- [`us_archive_download()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_archive_download.md)
  : Download and unpack annual archives
- [`us_archive_filter()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_archive_filter.md)
  : Filter unpacked archives down to a set of UEIs
- [`us_archive_verify_schema()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_archive_verify_schema.md)
  : Check that an archive matches the canonical field map

## Subawards

Pass-through paid (fetched by prime award) and subawards received (a
by-product of recipient-filtered pulls). Direction matters.

- [`us_fetch_subawards_batch()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_subawards_batch.md)
  : Batched outbound subaward fetch
- [`us_fetch_subawards_out()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_subawards_out.md)
  : Subawards paid out by a prime award
- [`us_fetch_subawards_in()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_subawards_in.md)
  : Fetch inbound subawards for a set of UEIs
- [`us_fetch_award()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_award.md)
  : Prime award overview
- [`us_subaward_by_year()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_subaward_by_year.md)
  : Aggregate subawards by year

## Annual outlays (File C)

The optional cash layer. Annual disbursements exist only in
account-level File C data, complete only from the FY2022 monthly mandate
and absent for whole agencies – fetched per award, graded for coverage,
and attached to a fiscal panel without ever substituting for
obligations.

- [`us_fetch_outlays()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_fetch_outlays.md)
  : Fetch account-level (File C) funding history per award
- [`us_outlays_by_year()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_outlays_by_year.md)
  : Collapse File C funding records to annual outlays per award
- [`us_add_outlays()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_add_outlays.md)
  : Attach annual outlays to a panel

## Outlay imputation

Where real File C outlays don’t reach, impute the cash calendar from
obligations: liquidation curves fitted on reconciled ground truth, with
an explicit even-spread fallback outside the model’s support.

- [`us_impute_outlays()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_impute_outlays.md)
  : Impute annual outlays from obligations data
- [`us_add_imputed_outlays()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_add_imputed_outlays.md)
  : Attach imputed outlays to a panel
- [`us_impute_fit()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_impute_fit.md)
  : Fit a liquidation-curve outlay model
- [`us_impute_eval()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_impute_eval.md)
  : Cross-validated evaluation of an outlay-imputation configuration
- [`us_outlay_training()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_outlay_training.md)
  : Build an outlay-imputation training set
- [`us_outlay_features()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_outlay_features.md)
  : Award-level features for outlay imputation
- [`us_misallocation()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_misallocation.md)
  : Misallocation share between an imputed and an actual annual series
- [`outlay_model`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/outlay_model.md)
  : The default liquidation-curve outlay model
- [`outlay_training`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/outlay_training.md)
  : Outlay-imputation ground truth

## Disruption

Detecting terminations, reductions, delays and transfers from the
non-monetary fields of the ledger – action codes, end-date and ceiling
changes, description text. See
[`vignette("disruption")`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/articles/disruption.md).

- [`us_disruption_flags()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_disruption_flags.md)
  : Flag disruption signals on a transaction ledger
- [`disruption_sample`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/disruption_sample.md)
  : Disruption in federal funding: a 1,000-nonprofit sample,
  FY2016–FY2026

## Normalization and accounting

The rules that turn a raw modification ledger into clean signed
transactions, specified in ACCOUNTING.md.

- [`us_normalize_transactions()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_normalize_transactions.md)
  : Normalize a raw transaction ledger
- [`us_normalize_awards()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_normalize_awards.md)
  : Build the prime award spine
- [`us_normalize_subawards()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_normalize_subawards.md)
  : Normalize a subaward ledger and assign direction
- [`us_ledger()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_ledger.md)
  : Build a signed accounting ledger
- [`us_net_by_year()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_net_by_year.md)
  : Net an award ledger into organization x award x year records
- [`us_money_column()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_money_column.md)
  : Which transaction amount counts as money

## Reconciliation and audit

External and structural checks, run on every rebuild.

- [`us_reconcile()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_reconcile.md)
  : Reconcile netted transactions against award lifetime totals
- [`us_audit()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/us_audit.md)
  : Audit a finished panel

## Example data

Vanderbilt University Medical Center, FY2008-FY2025 - a complete
single-organization example shipped with the package: raw transactions,
subawards in both directions, and the finished panel.

- [`vumc_transactions`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/vumc_transactions.md)
  : Vanderbilt University Medical Center: raw transactions
- [`vumc_subawards`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/vumc_subawards.md)
  : Vanderbilt University Medical Center: subaward rows, both directions
- [`vumc_panel`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/usaspend/reference/vumc_panel.md)
  : Vanderbilt University Medical Center: the finished panel
